configurationFields.label: Servername
configurationFields.description: Sets the name of the server that is displayed in the server list

configurationFields.label: Serverbeschreibung
configurationFields.description: Sets the server description as it appears publicly

configurationFields.label: Randomizer Type
configurationFields.description: Sets the type of randomizer to use

configurationFields.label: Randomizer Seed
configurationFields.description: Sets the seed for the randomizer

configurationFields.label: Enable Full Pal Level Randomization
configurationFields.description: If enabled, the wild pals level will be fully randomized. Otherwise, wild pals will be randomized within a level optimized with the area

configurationFields.label: Server Region
configurationFields.description: Sets the region for the server

configurationFields.label: Make Community Server
configurationFields.description: If enabled, the server will appear in the list of community servers in-game

configurationFields.label: Server Public IP
configurationFields.description: Sets the public IP advertised for the server. Useful if the host network has multiple public IPs, or the server is behind a public proxy

configurationFields.label: Public Port Selection Mode
configurationFields.description: Sets whether the public port advertised for the server should be the same as the Game Port, or whether it should be the custom port set under Server Public Port

configurationFields.label: Server Public Port
configurationFields.description: Sets the public port advertised for the server, if "Use custom port" is selected as the Public Port Selection Mode

configurationFields.label: Serverpasswort
configurationFields.description: Sets the password required for players to join the server. Default is no password

configurationFields.label: RCON/Admin Password
configurationFields.description: See the Security and Privacy menu for configurable options for the server's RCON password. The RCON password is also used in the in-game console for players to access administrator commands

configurationFields.label: RCON aktivieren
configurationFields.description: If set, RCON will be enabled.

configurationFields.label: Enable REST API
configurationFields.description: If set, the REST API will be enabled. Requires a new GSCS instance as of Palworld 1.0

configurationFields.label: Enable Game Data API
configurationFields.description: If set, the game data will be accessible through the REST API. Requires Enable REST API to be set

configurationFields.label: Spielerlimit
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum number of players allowed on the server at one time. 32 is the maximum officially supported

configurationFields.label: Co-op Player Limit
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum number of players allowed on the server at one time in co-op mode

configurationFields.label: Show Player List
configurationFields.description: If set, the player list can be shown in-game by pressing the ESC key

configurationFields.label: Enable Multi-Threaded Performance Improvements
configurationFields.description: If enabled, the server's performance will be enhanced in multi-threaded CPU environments. In v1.0 and later, this may decrease performance. May cause the server to crash on Windows if enabled

configurationFields.label: Process Thread Number
configurationFields.description: Sets the number of process threads that the server will use. Multi-Threaded Performance Improvements must be enabled. Maximum = CPU thread count - 1. Empty = disabled

configurationFields.label: Enable Authentication
configurationFields.description: If set, enables server authentication

configurationFields.label: Ban List URL
configurationFields.description: Sets the URL for the server ban list

configurationFields.label: Allow Client Mods
configurationFields.description: If set, allows players with mods enabled to join the server

configurationFields.label: Show Join/Leave Messages
configurationFields.description: If set, shows in-game messages when players join and leave

configurationFields.label: Crossplay Platforms
configurationFields.description: Comma-separated list of platforms that can connect to the server. Available options: Steam, Xbox, PS5, Mac

configurationFields.label: Enable Steam Workshop Mods (Windows)
configurationFields.description: If set, the mods listed under Active Steam Workshop Mods List will be enabled on the server, if they are installed. Steam Workshop mods can be downloaded from the Steam Workshop under Updates>Steam Workshop, or installed manually in the 'Mods/Workshop' folder. Windows only

configurationFields.label: Active Steam Workshop Mods List (Windows)
configurationFields.description: List of Steam Workshop mods to enable on the server. Example: ActiveModList=PalSync. One mod per line. Use the PackageName of each mod from the mod's Info.json file. [More information](https://docs.palworldgame.com/settings-and-operation/mod#enabling-mods-via-palmodsettingsini). Requires the mods to be installed, and Enable Steam Workshop Mods to be set. Windows only

configurationFields.label: Enable World Backup
configurationFields.description: If set, the server's automatic backup will be enabled. Disk load will increase

configurationFields.label: Auto Save Interval
configurationFields.description: Sets the in-game auto save interval

configurationFields.label: Log Format
configurationFields.description: Sets the server's logging format

configurationFields.label: Enable UE4SS UObject Listeners (Windows)
configurationFields.description: If set, UObject listeners will be created in GUObjectArray to create a fast cache for use instead of iterating GUObjectArray. Recommended to keep disabled for UE4SS mods to avoid crashes. Windows only

configurationFields.label: Custom Command Line Arguments
configurationFields.description: Sets custom command line arguments. Don't use arguments already in GSCS's settings!

configurationFields.label: Custom Settings
configurationFields.description: Comma-separated list of additional settings to include in "PalWorldSettings.ini" that are not otherwise set by GSCS. Useful for new settings that are not yet in GSCS's UI. Use with care

configurationFields.label: Difficulty Level
configurationFields.description: Sets the game difficulty level

configurationFields.label: Death Penalty
configurationFields.description: Sets the penalty on player death

configurationFields.label: Enable Player To Player Damage
configurationFields.description: If set, enables player-to-player damage

configurationFields.label: Enable Friendly Fire
configurationFields.description: If set, enables friendly fire

configurationFields.label: Enable Invader Enemies
configurationFields.description: If set, enables invader enemies

configurationFields.label: Activate UNKO
configurationFields.description: If set, activates UNKO

configurationFields.label: Enable Pad Aim Assist
configurationFields.description: If set, enables aim assist for pad controls

configurationFields.label: Enable Keyboard Aim Assist
configurationFields.description: If set, enables aim assist for keyboard controls

configurationFields.label: Drop Items Limit
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum number of drop items

configurationFields.label: Physics Active Drop Item Max Number
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum number of dropped items that can use physics behavior. Set to -1 for unlimited

configurationFields.label: UNKO Drop Items Limit
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum number of UNKO drop items

configurationFields.label: Base Camps Limit
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum number of base camps

configurationFields.label: Base Camps Per Guild Limit
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum number of base camps per guild. Larger values increase system load

configurationFields.label: Base Camp Workers Limit
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum number of workers at base camps. Larger values increase system load

configurationFields.label: Drop Item Alive Time Maximum
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum time a drop item remains alive

configurationFields.label: Enable Guild Auto Reset
configurationFields.description: If set, enables automatic reset of a guild with no online players

configurationFields.label: Guild Auto Reset Time
configurationFields.description: Sets the time for automatic reset of a guild with no online players. Guild Auto Reset must be enabled

configurationFields.label: Guild Player Limit
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum number of players in a guild

configurationFields.label: Guild Rejoin Cooldown Period
configurationFields.description: Sets the cooldown period before a player can rejoin a guild

configurationFields.label: Auto Transfer Master Check Interval
configurationFields.description: Sets the interval to check the auto transfer master

configurationFields.label: Auto Transfer Master Threshold
configurationFields.description: Sets the max threshold for auto transfer master

configurationFields.label: Max Guilds Per Frame
configurationFields.description: Sets the max guilds per frame

configurationFields.label: Egg Hatching Time
configurationFields.description: Sets the time to incubate a massive egg

configurationFields.label: Enable Multiplayer
configurationFields.description: If set, enables multiplayer

configurationFields.label: Enable PvP
configurationFields.description: If set, enables Player vs Player (PvP) mode. Enable Player To Player Damage and  Enable Defending Other Guild Players must also be set. [Recommended settings for PvP servers](https://docs.palworldgame.com/settings-and-operation/pvp#recommended-server-settings-when-enabling-pvp)

configurationFields.label: Enable Hardcore Mode
configurationFields.description: If set, hardcore mode will be enabled

configurationFields.label: Enable Pal Loss On Death
configurationFields.description: If set, Pals will be permanently lost on death

configurationFields.label: Enable Character Recreation In Hardcore Mode
configurationFields.description: If set, characters will be recreated in hardcore mode

configurationFields.label: Display PVP Items In Bases
configurationFields.description: If set, shows the number of PvP-exclusive items in each base on the map

configurationFields.label: Display PVP Items On Players
configurationFields.description: If set, shows player locations and the number of PvP-exclusive items on the map

configurationFields.label: Enable Death Penalty Pickup
configurationFields.description: If set, allows picking up death penalty items from other guilds

configurationFields.label: Enable Non-Login Penalty
configurationFields.description: If set, enables non-login penalty

configurationFields.label: Enable Fast Travel
configurationFields.description: If set, enables fast travel

configurationFields.label: Enable Fast Travel Only Base Camps
configurationFields.description: If set, restricts fast travel to between bases only

configurationFields.label: Enable Start Location Selection By Map
configurationFields.description: If set, enables starting location selection by map

configurationFields.label: Enable Player Existence After Logout
configurationFields.description: If set, enables player existence after logout

configurationFields.label: Enable Defending Other Guild Players
configurationFields.description: If set, enables defending other guild's players

configurationFields.label: Enable Hiding Palbox Circles
configurationFields.description: If set, enables hiding palbox circles from other guild's players

configurationFields.label: Set Build Area Limit
configurationFields.description: If set, building near structures such as fast travel will be prohibited

configurationFields.label: Meteorite and Supply Drop Interval
configurationFields.description: Sets the meteorite and supply drop interval

configurationFields.label: Chat Post Limit Per Minute
configurationFields.description: Sets the limit for the number of chat posts per minute

configurationFields.label: Enable Predator Boss Pal
configurationFields.description: If set, the predator boss pal will be enabled

configurationFields.label: Building Limit Per Player
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum number of buildings allowed per player. 0 = unlimited

configurationFields.label: Pal Sync Distance
configurationFields.description: Sets the pal sync distance from a player

configurationFields.label: Allow Saving To Global Palbox
configurationFields.description: If set, saving to the global palbox will be allowed

configurationFields.label: Allow Importing From Global Palbox
configurationFields.description: If set, importing from the global palbox will be allowed

configurationFields.label: Allow Stat Allocation - Attack
configurationFields.description: If set, allows allocating stat points to Attack

configurationFields.label: Allow Stat Allocation - Health
configurationFields.description: If set, allows allocating stat points to Health

configurationFields.label: Allow Stat Allocation - Stamina
configurationFields.description: If set, allows allocating stat points to Stamina

configurationFields.label: Allow Stat Allocation - Weight
configurationFields.description: If set, allows allocating stat points to Weight

configurationFields.label: Allow Stat Allocation - Work Speed
configurationFields.description: If set, allows allocating stat points to Work Speed

configurationFields.label: Enable Building Player UI Display
configurationFields.description: If set, creator’s player ID will display on structures.

configurationFields.label: Building Name Display Cache TTL
configurationFields.description: How long to cache the player name displayed on structures

configurationFields.label: Enable Additional Drop Item In PVP
configurationFields.description: If set, players will drop a special item when killed while PvP is enabled. Additional Drop Item In PVP Item ID and Additional Drop Item In PVP Amount must also be set

configurationFields.label: Enable Voice Chat
configurationFields.description: If set, enable in-game voice chat

configurationFields.label: Voice Chat Max Volume Distance
configurationFields.description: The distance between players where they can hear the in-game voice chat at max volume

configurationFields.label: Voice Chat Zero Volume Distance
configurationFields.description: The distance between players where they can no longer hear the in-game voice chat

configurationFields.label: Additional Drop Item In PVP Item ID
configurationFields.description: If Enable Additional Drop Item In PVP is set, sets the ID of the item to drop

configurationFields.label: Additional Drop Item In PVP Amount
configurationFields.description: If Enable Additional Drop Item In PVP is set, sets the quantity of the item to drop

configurationFields.label: Deny Technology List
configurationFields.description: Disable specific technologies by specifying [Technology IDs](https://docs.palworldgame.com/settings-and-operation/technologyids). Must follow the exact format: "ItemID1", "ItemID2"

configurationFields.label: Day Time Speed Rate
configurationFields.description: Sets the day time speed rate

configurationFields.label: Night Time Speed Rate
configurationFields.description: Sets the night time speed rate

configurationFields.label: Experience Rate
configurationFields.description: Sets the experience rate

configurationFields.label: Pal Capture Rate
configurationFields.description: Sets the pal capture rate

configurationFields.label: Pal Appearance Rate
configurationFields.description: Sets the pal appearance rate

configurationFields.label: Pal Attack Damage Multiplier
configurationFields.description: Sets the damage from pals multiplier

configurationFields.label: Pal Defence Damage Multiplier
configurationFields.description: Sets the damage to pals multiplier

configurationFields.label: Pal Hunger Depletion Rate
configurationFields.description: Sets the pal hunger depletion rate

configurationFields.label: Pal Stamina Depletion Rate
configurationFields.description: Sets the pal stamina reduction rate

configurationFields.label: Pal Auto HP Regeneration Rate
configurationFields.description: Sets the pal auto HP regeneration rate

configurationFields.label: Pal Sleep Auto HP Regeneration Rate
configurationFields.description: Sets the pal sleep HP regeneration rate

configurationFields.label: Build Object HP Rate
configurationFields.description: Sets the rate of HP for build objects

configurationFields.label: Player Attack Damage Multiplier
configurationFields.description: Sets the damage from player multiplier

configurationFields.label: Player Defence Damage Multiplier
configurationFields.description: Sets the damage to player multiplier

configurationFields.label: Player Hunger Depletion Rate
configurationFields.description: Sets the player hunger depletion rate

configurationFields.label: Player Stamina Depletion Rate
configurationFields.description: Sets the player stamina reduction rate

configurationFields.label: Player Auto HP Regeneration Rate
configurationFields.description: Sets the player auto HP regeneration rate

configurationFields.label: Player Sleep Auto HP Regeneration Rate
configurationFields.description: Sets the player sleep HP regeneration rate

configurationFields.label: Structure Damage Multiplier
configurationFields.description: Sets the damage to structures multiplier

configurationFields.label: Structure Deterioration Rate
configurationFields.description: Sets the structure deterioration rate

configurationFields.label: Gatherable Items Multiplier
configurationFields.description: Sets the gatherable items multiplier

configurationFields.label: Gatherable Objects HP Multiplier
configurationFields.description: Sets the gatherable objects HP multiplier

configurationFields.label: Gatherable Objects Respawn Interval
configurationFields.description: Sets the gatherable objects respawn interval

configurationFields.label: Enemy Dropped Items Multiplier
configurationFields.description: Sets the enemy dropped items multiplier

configurationFields.label: Work Speed Rate
configurationFields.description: Sets the work speed multiplier

configurationFields.label: Item Weight Ratio
configurationFields.description: Sets the item weight ratio

configurationFields.label: Equipment Durability Damage Rate
configurationFields.description: Sets the equipment durability loss multiplier

configurationFields.label: Item Container Force Mark Dirty Interval
configurationFields.description: Sets the interval for force sync when open the container

configurationFields.label: Player Data Pal Storage Update Check Tick Interval
configurationFields.description: Sets the interval for updating the pal storage

configurationFields.label: Monster Farm Action Speed Rate
configurationFields.description: Sets the item production speed multiplier from grazing

configurationFields.label: Item Decay Rate Multiplier
configurationFields.description: Sets the rate items decay or spoil

configurationFields.label: Block Respawn Time
configurationFields.description: Sets the cooldown period before a player can respawn after death

configurationFields.label: Respawn Penalty Time Scale
configurationFields.description: Sets the multiplier applied to the respawn cooldown period

configurationFields.label: Respawn Penalty Duration Threshold
configurationFields.description: Sets the survival-time threshold for applying the respawn cooldown multiplier set by Respawn Penalty Time Scale on a subsequent death

configurationFields.label: Install UE Scripting System (Windows)
configurationFields.description: Sets the action to take when the server is updated. If an installation option is selected, the selected build of the Unreal Engine 4/5 Scripting System will be installed from either the [UE4SS-RE repo](https://github.com/UE4SS-RE/RE-UE4SS) or the [Okaetsu forked repo](https://github.com/Okaetsu/RE-UE4SS), allowing the server to be modded without using the Steam Workshop. Also set the Specific UE4SS-RE Experimental Build Version if relevant. Windows only

options.experimental-palworld: Install latest Okaetsu experimental build (recommended build)

configurationFields.label: Specific UE4SS-RE Experimental Build Version
configurationFields.description: If "Install specific UE4SS-RE experimental build" is selected under Install UE Scripting System, sets the [relevant UE4SS-RE version](https://github.com/UE4SS-RE/RE-UE4SS/releases/tag/experimental) to install. Example: v3.0.1-137-g6867a08
